name: Exp_i-SpectrAnalysis_WPR
summary: This EA trades based on a spectral analysis filter applied to the Williams Percent Range (WPR) indicator. It identifies turning points in the smoothed WPR line to generate buy and sell signals, opening and closing positions accordingly with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于对威廉指标(WPR)进行频谱分析滤波后的信号进行交易。它识别平滑WPR线的拐点来产生买卖信号，并据此开平仓，支持可配置的资金管理和止损止盈。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是对WPR（威廉百分比范围）指标进行频谱分析滤波处理，去除高频噪声后提取主要趋势转折信号。入场条件为：当滤波后WPR值从下降转为上升（Value[0]>=Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时开多仓，当从上升转为下降（Value[0]<=Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时开空仓。出场条件由反向信号触发，即多头在出现空头信号时平仓，空头在出现多头信号时平仓，同时设有固定的止损和止盈。仓位管理支持五种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按可用保证金减浮亏比例、按余额减浮亏比例、或固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制交易量比例，MMMode参数选择具体的计算模式。策略使用了IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is applying spectral analysis filtering to the WPR (Williams Percent Range) indicator, removing high-frequency noise to extract major trend reversal signals. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the filtered WPR value turns from declining to rising (Value[0]>=Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]), and a sell position is opened when it turns from rising to declining (Value[0]<=Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions are triggered by opposing signals — long positions close on bearish signals and short positions close on bullish signals, with additional fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin minus floating loss, percentage of balance minus floating loss, or fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter for trade volume ratio and the MMMode parameter for selecting the specific calculation mode. The strategy uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing redundant trades.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（保证金/余额/固定手数等）
parameters.description_en: Margin mode: free margin/balance/drawdown free margin/drawdown balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow buy position close on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow sell position close on reverse signal

parameters.name: N
parameters.description: 频谱分析中FFT的幂次（2^N为数据长度）

pros: 频谱分析滤波有效去除WPR指标的高频噪声，减少虚假信号
支持多种资金管理模式，灵活适应不同交易风格
使用IsNewBar机制避免同一K线内重复交易，逻辑严谨
止损止盈参数可配置，风险可控
买卖方向的开仓和平仓可独立开关控制，灵活性高
pros_en: Spectral analysis filtering effectively removes high-frequency noise from the WPR indicator, reducing false signals
Supports multiple money management modes, flexibly adapting to different trading styles
Uses IsNewBar mechanism to prevent redundant trades within the same bar, ensuring rigorous logic
Configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters provide controllable risk
Buy and sell direction open/close can be independently toggled, offering high flexibility
cons: 频谱分析依赖自定义指标i-SpectrAnalysis_WPR，黑盒性强，缺乏透明度
没有检查是否已存在同方向持仓，可能导致重复开仓
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，不适合所有品种和周期
没有 Spread 过滤，在高点差环境下可能不利
信号仅依赖单一指标的拐点判断，缺乏多维度确认
cons_en: Spectral analysis relies on the custom i-SpectrAnalysis_WPR indicator, creating a black-box dependency with limited transparency
No check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially leading to duplicate openings
Default stop-loss of 1000 and take-profit of 2000 points are excessively large for some instruments and timeframes
No spread filter, which may be disadvantageous in high-spread environments
Signals rely solely on turning points of a single indicator, lacking multi-dimensional confirmation
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓
增加点差过滤和最大持仓数量限制，提高风险控制能力
improvements_en: Add position check logic to avoid duplicate openings in the same direction
Add spread filter and maximum position count limit to improve risk control

risk_points: 没有检查是否已存在同方向持仓，可能在趋势行情中反复开仓导致过度暴露
默认止损止盈点数较大，在小周期或波动性低的品种上可能不合适
risk_points_en: No existing position check in the same direction, potentially leading to repeated openings and overexposure during trending markets
Default SL/TP values are large and may not be suitable for lower timeframes or low-volatility instruments
